description: This file defines classes and data structures for managing spatial reference systems (SRS), including mappings between SRID and CRS identifiers, with support for geographic and cartesian systems. It includes data classes, singleton cache, and mapper classes for SRS lookup.

classes.name: SpatialReferenceSystemInformation
classes.description: Immutable data class representing information about a spatial reference system, including SRID, string ID, and whether it is geographic.

classes.name: SpatialReferenceSystemCache
classes.description: Singleton class that maintains mappings between SRID/CRS identifiers and spatial reference system info, with methods to retrieve SRS data.

classes.name: GeographicSpatialReferenceSystemMapper
classes.description: Provides static methods to get string ID and SRID for geographic SRS based on SRID or string ID.

classes.name: CartesianSpatialReferenceSystemMapper
classes.description: Provides static methods to get string ID and SRID for cartesian SRS based on SRID or string ID.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of SpatialReferenceSystemCache.

methods.name: _populate_srs_information_mapping
methods.description: Initializes the SRID and string ID mappings with predefined SRS data.

methods.name: get_srs_by_srid
methods.description: Retrieves SRS information based on SRID.

methods.name: get_srs_by_string_id
methods.description: Retrieves SRS information based on string ID.

methods.name: get_string_id
methods.description: Returns the string ID for a given SRID if it is geographic.

methods.name: get_srid
methods.description: Returns the SRID for a given string ID if it is geographic.
